text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how many hours I wait, Tosen 
Jordan doesn't show up for training. 
Worried, I search all over the place, 
and..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Oh crap! I completely forgot about that. 
I'm so, so sorry~~~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, my head was just completely full of 
the new Grape Frappe, ahaha...☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I really, um... I didn't think I'd kept 
you waitin' that long.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'll be careful from now on! Oh, I know! 
How about I treat you to something to make 
up for it!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you're safe, but you've let your 
guard down. I gave them a strict scolding.
